INDUSTRIAL DISPUTE. 


Im connection with the dispute of some 200 workers of 
the “Record” Machine Tools Mfg. Co., 111 Great Western Road, who 
were demending a rice allowance, an agreement has been concluded. 


At the request of Mr. S. Jedeikin, Nanager of the Com- 
pany, the Industrial Section Representative proceeded to the 
factory at 11 a.m. September 14th, to attend a consultation. 
after consideration, tr. Jedeikin decided to grant a rice allow 
ance of $5 each per month, effective from September 16th, while 
the price of first gerade Seigon rice was at the present iewel of 
$65 per picul. No rice allowance would be anted when the 
price of first grade Saigon rice fell below $55 per picul. A 
notice was issued by the Vanagement to this effect. 


The dispute has, therefore, been concluded.

上海市滬西特別警察總署
Western Shanghai Area Special Police Force
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
SPECIAL BRANCH REGISTRY
385
10 / 4 / 41

Shanghai, April 9th 1941.

Special Branch Report No. 2.
Strike at the Record Tools Mfg. Co. 111 St. Western Road.
Diary No. 1.

At 2.15 p.m. 9/4/41, a telephone message was received from the above works reporting that, at about 8 a.m. 9/4/41, a party of about 100 strikers had gained entry to the works, stopped the staff in two other departments, and were now threatening to be unruly.

Insptr. Wilkinson of the Foreign Affairs Branch, D.I. Kamishita and D.S.I. Weeks of the Special Branch together with the Reserve Unit under Insptr. Koh, attended.

From enquiries it was learnt that the workers had made three new demands namely :-
$5.00 increase in wages.
$10.00 increase in rice allowance.
$50.00 increase in H.C.L. allowance.

However, the management were only willing to grant an increase of $5.00 in the rice allowance, and refused to consider the other demands.

After mediation by the police, management and Lau Ling Hwei of the Social Movement Direction Committee at 10 Edinburgh Road, it was agreed that the strikers appoint several delegates to meet the management with a view to coming to a peaceful settlement.

On the management agreeing that an answer will be given to the delegates on the 11/4/41, the strikers left the works. No untoward incident took place.

Police from the 5th Division are at present posted in the premises.

（印：SPECIAL BRANCH 10 APR 1941）

(Sgd) J. Weeks, D.S.I.

1941年4月10日

上海，1941年4月9日。

特务科报告第2号。
大西路111号雷卡德工具制造公司（Record Tools Mfg. Co.）罢工事件。
日志第1号。

1941年4月9日下午2时15分，接到上述工厂电话报告称，约于当日上午8时，一群约100名的罢工工人进入工厂，阻止了另外两个部门的职员工作，并扬言要采取过激行动。

外事科威尔金森（Wilkinson）巡官、特务科上席探员神下（Kamishita）及上席副探员威克斯（Weeks），连同由科赫（Koh）巡官率领的后备队前往处置。

经查询获悉，工人提出了三项新要求，即：
工资增加5.00元。
米贴增加10.00元。
生活成本津贴（H.C.L. allowance）增加50.00元。

然而，资方仅同意将米贴增加5.00元，并拒绝考虑其他要求。

经警方、资方以及爱丁堡路10号社会运动指导委员会的刘灵辉（Lau Ling Hwei，音译）调解，双方达成协议，由罢工工人推选数名代表与资方会面，以期和平解决争端。

鉴于资方同意于1941年4月11日向代表们给予答复，罢工工人遂离开工厂。期间未发生任何意外事件。

目前，第五分区警员已驻守该厂区。

（印：特务科 1941年4月10日）

（签名）J. 威克斯，上席副探员。

劳资纠纷。

关于大西路111号“雷卡德”机器工具制造公司约200名工人要求发放米贴的纠纷，现已达成协议。

应该公司经理 S. Jedeikin 先生的请求，工业科代表于9月14日上午11时前往工厂参加协商。经考虑，Jedeikin 先生决定自9月16日起，每人每月发放米贴5元，前提是上等西贡米价格维持在每担65元的现行水平。若上等西贡米价格跌至每担55元以下，则不发放米贴。资方已就此发布通告。

因此，该纠纷已告解决。
